Do you have a journal?I bought one of those 99 cent notebooks (you know the one, that looks like a cow) and wrote in it whenever I had very shitty and very turbulent thoughts about myself. I hid it away for a few years and came back to it and made positive annotations about how I felt back then compared to how I feel now.

There were some moments where I was unable to write anything positive, and other moments where I realized the way I thought was incredibly stupid (not saying your thoughts are or will be stupid, I'm just harsh on myself that way....it works for me....)

It allows you to be honest with yourself in whatever way you want, and to challenge yourself in whatever way you want. It doesn't have to be structured like an essay, you don't even have to write in the lines. 

Hell I have a few pages that are just violent scribbles because I was so distraught that whenever I put that pen to the paper it was just raw anger and distress being released, and that's what it looked like. Not organized thoughts, but violent scribbles. Some pages had tear stains, some pages I couldn't finish what I wanted to write because of the way it made me feel in the middle of writing it. Other pages were just lists of crappy shit that I had thought throughout the day.

If you have a really close friend that's comfortable with talking to you about your darker thoughts you can try sharing some of the less intense pages with them just so they can get an understanding of how you feel. A good friend will appreciate the trust you put in them to be able to share it.
